title: The Watchers
blurb: Follow one strange story of fallen angels from Genesis through Enoch to the New Testament.

steps.title: Genesis 6:1–4
steps.note: The "sons of God" take human wives and the Nephilim appear. Four verses that later writers could not leave alone.

steps.title: 1 Enoch 6–8
steps.note: The Book of the Watchers expands Genesis into a full narrative: two hundred angels, an oath on Mount Hermon, forbidden knowledge.

steps.title: 1 Enoch 9–10
steps.note: The archangels intercede and judgment is pronounced. Azâzêl is bound in the darkness.

steps.title: Book of Jubilees 5
steps.note: A second-century BCE retelling that folds the Watchers into the flood story.

steps.title: Jude 6, 14–15
steps.note: A New Testament letter quotes 1 Enoch 1:9 directly: "Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints."
